name: Azure
description:
Builds and runs a team's own Azure resources, signed in as the person: resource groups, Bicep and ARM deployments checked by what-if first, registry builds, Azure SQL databases and SQL, storage blobs, tables and queues, Key Vault, Container Apps with their logs and custom domains, DNS zones, budgets and role assignments for its managed identities. Key Vault and the apps' logs are reached through Azure management, so the Microsoft sign-in asks for Azure management, Azure SQL and Azure Storage only.

It changes only what it created, which carries the tags yawble-owner and yawble-plugin, plus the shared SQL servers and registries a person lists. It acts with the person's own Azure rights, never more. What-if by default: every changing command says what it would do and changes nothing until a person sets mode to apply. It never reads a key, a connection string or a Key Vault secret's value, and no token reaches its output; an app's secret comes from Key Vault or from an API-key connection bound to its appSecrets slot, set in Team settings -> Connections, and its value is never written out.

subscription.label: Subscription ID
subscription.description: The id of the Azure subscription this member works in, such as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000; run setup after signing in and it lists the subscriptions your account can read.

regions.label: Regions
regions.description: The Azure regions resource groups may be created in, chosen from the list; eastus2 unless a person picks others.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: whatif answers what each changing command would do and changes nothing in Azure; apply makes the changes.

allowDelete.label: Allow deletes
allowDelete.description: Off: every delete is refused, in whatif and apply; on: the member may delete what its team owns.

sharedSqlServers.label: Shared SQL servers
sharedSqlServers.description: Existing SQL servers, by name such as my-sql-server, on which the member may create its own databases; it never changes the server or another database on it.

sharedContainerRegistries.label: Shared container registries
sharedContainerRegistries.description: Existing Azure Container Registries (ACR), by name such as myregistry, that the member may build and push images to and grant pull rights on to its own managed identities; a Container App's image is pulled from one of them.

sharedRegistries.label: Shared registries (old name)
sharedRegistries.description: The old name of sharedContainerRegistries, still read; move its registries to sharedContainerRegistries.

monthlyBudget.label: Monthly budget
monthlyBudget.description: A monthly budget, in the subscription's currency, put on every resource group the member creates, with alerts at 80% and 100%; 0 means no budget.

budgetEmails.label: Budget alert emails
budgetEmails.description: The email addresses the budget alerts go to; needed when monthlyBudget is more than 0.

namePrefix.label: Resource group name prefix
namePrefix.description: Text put before the name of every resource group the member creates, such as team1-; empty by default.

namedSecrets.description: Old: named app secrets set here before 3.0.0, still read by name after the appSecrets connections, so an app that names one keeps working; the name is how the team refers to it. Add new ones as fields of an API-key connection (preset Other) in Team settings -> Connections, bound to the appSecrets slot, and remove the old one here once it is there.

microsoft.description: The Microsoft account that signs in to Azure; the member acts with that account's own Azure rights.

appSecrets.description: The secrets an app made by containerapp create reads as secret environment variables: API-key connections (preset Other), each field one secret by the name the team refers to it with, through secret=<NAME>=<field name>. Added and assigned to this team in Team settings -> Connections; bind as many as needed. A value is never shown again or written out.
